name: Araquanid

attacks.name: Corner
attacks.text: During your opponent’s next turn, the Defending Pokémon can’t retreat.

flavor:
It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose
consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles
will get torn apart by Araquanid’s gnashing jaws.
